clients.name: ImapClient
clients.description: Represents an IMAP Client, which interacts with an IMAP Server.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Gets invoked during the `email:ImapClient` initialization.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Port number of the IMAP server

return.description: An `email:Error` if failed while creating the client or else `()`

functions.name: receiveMessage
functions.description:
Reads a message.
```ballerina
email:Message|email:Error emailResponse = imapClient->receiveMessage();
```

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Folder to read emails. The default value is `INBOX`

return.description:
An `email:Message` if reading the message is successful, `()` if there are no emails in the specified
folder, or else an `email:Error` if the recipient failed to receive the message

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Close the client.
```ballerina
email:Error? closeResponse = imapClient->close();
```

return.description: An `email:Error` if the recipient failed to close the client or else `()`

clients.name: PopClient
clients.description: Represents a POP Client, which interacts with a POP Server.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Gets invoked during the `email:PopClient` initialization.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Port number of the POP server

return.description: An `email:Error` if creating the client failed or else `()`

functions.name: receiveMessage
functions.description:
Reads a message.
```ballerina
email:Message|email:Error? emailResponse = popClient->receiveMessage();
```

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Folder to read the emails. The default value is `INBOX`

return.description:
An `email:Message` if reading the message is successful,
`()` if there are no emails in the specified folder,
or else an `email:Error` if the recipient failed to receive the message

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Close the client.
```ballerina
email:Error? closeResponse = popClient->close();
```

return.description: An `email:Error` if the recipient failed to close the client or else `()`

clients.name: SmtpClient
clients.description: Represents an SMTP Client, which interacts with an SMTP Server.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Gets invoked during the `email:SmtpClient` initialization.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username of the SMTP Client if authentication is required

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password of the SMTP Client if authentication is required

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Port number of the SMTP server

return.description: An `email:Error` if failed to initialize or else `()`

functions.name: sendMessage
functions.description:
Sends an email message.
```ballerina
email:Error? response = smtpClient->sendMessage(email);
```

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: An `email:Message` message, which needs to be sent to the recipient

return.description: An `email:Error` if failed to send the message to the recipient or else `()`

functions.name: send
functions.description:
Sends an email message with optional parameters.
```ballerina
email:Error? response = smtpClient->send(toAddress, subject, fromAddress,
  emailBody, sender="eve@abc.com");
```

parameters.name: htmlBody
parameters.description: HTML typed body of the email message

return.description: An `email:Error` if failed to send the message to the recipient or else `()`
